title: Lapsed Quantity Limit Approvals: Units Added When a First-Time Exception Is Approved
content:
Under the Utilization Management Program a lapsed approval shows need already established, and it adds units to the approval ceiling of a first-time quantity limit exception on an acute migraine drug:

| Member's quantity limit authorization for the drug | Units added |
|---|---|
| one whose last day in force fell within the last 6 months | 2 |
| one whose last day in force fell within the last 12 months but not the last 6 | 1 |
| no quantity limit authorization for the drug ending within the last 12 months | 0 |

**Counting the months.** The windows end on the decision date: a last day in force falls within the last N months when it is dated after the same day of the month N months before the decision date. The date read is the authorization's expiration date, its last day in force. Only quantity limit authorizations for the same drug count.

**More than one authorization.** The units follow the most recent window reached: a member with one authorization that ended 4 months before and another that ended 10 months before takes 2 units.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical decision date 15 September)

| Last day in force | Within 6 months (after 15 March) | Within 12 months (after 15 September of the year before) | Units |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16 March | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| 15 March | No | Yes | 1 |
| 16 September of the year before | No | Yes | 1 |
| 15 September of the year before | No | No | 0 |
